svg.text: What is plaintext, what is sealed, how to restore one set, and what an update keeps.
CRITICAL = losing it loses every account
Backups and exports live outside data/.
Copy them with the same care as the data itself.
Only the salts, configuration and runtime notes are plaintext.
Every database, vault and workspace is an AES-256-GCM envelope.
system.db alone is useless without the admin password.
auth.json alone is useless without install.salt.
Never mix files from two different installations.
A manifest mismatch rotates system.key, not the data key.
Desktop: stop the server, copy the whole folder.
The archive is encrypted because it contains install.salt.
Stop the server; replace program files only. Never delete data/.
install.salt and auth.json stay, so every account keeps its password.
system.db, users/<sha256>.db and files/users/ reconnect on start.
Sessions live in memory: each user signs in again with the same account.
Only system.key rotates; it is a displayed fingerprint, not a data key.
